Substitute Ordinance

BE IT ORDAINED BY THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CHICAGO

Section 1. Title 17 of the Municipal Code of Chicago, the Chicago Zoning
Ordinance, is hereby amended by the changing all of the B3-2 Community Shopping
District symbols and indications as shown on Map No. 2°G in the area bound by:

West Taylor Street; a line of 125 feet east of and parallel to South Loomis Street; a
public alley next south of and parallel to West Taylor Street; and a line 100 feet east
of and parallel to South Loomis Street

to those of B2-3 Neighborhood Mixed-Use District.

Section 2. This ordinance shall be in force and effect from and after its passage and
due publication.

Common Address of Property: 1849 West Taylor Street, Chicago, Illinois.
